texts.content:
Thanks to their high intake of organic matter, certain infected
individuals reduce their voracity and specialize in annihilation and
swarm defense, developing additional limbs used as weapons.
These structures, composed of hardened cartilage and reconfigured
bone, can be generated by their own metabolism or assembled
from the remains of fallen bodies. The process is rapid and
adaptive: new limbs emerge in response to prey type or environment,
allowing them to modify their combat style in real time.

This type of infected becomes an exceptionally difficult opponent
to eliminate. Not only does it possess escalating offensive power,
but it also exhibits anomalous resistance to physical damage.
Its body constantly reorganizes, absorbing and repurposing
biomass to reinforce defenses or regenerate lost parts.
In prolonged engagements, it can overpower even specialized units,
functioning as a mobile aggression node that demands
immediate and coordinated response.
